g.text: AdGuard Home: DNS for the whole lab
Clients only ever talk to one address. Three LXCs share it; Saga is the origin that the others copy.
Three AdGuard LXCs, one per Proxmox host
first in line for the VIP
One node down: the next in line
All three down: rewrites stop resolving.
How one query is answered, in order
Sources: docs/services/adguard.md, docs/architecture/network.md. No addresses or IDs on purpose: they live in the text docs.
